title: Retrieve several orders at once
request:
Add `OrderController.handle_get_many(order_ids)`.

- `order_ids` must be a list of 1 to 100 strings; otherwise return status 400 with `{"error": "order_ids must be a list of 1 to 100 strings"}`.
- Otherwise return status 200 with `{"orders": [...], "missing": [...]}`. `orders` holds the body `handle_get` would return for each id that exists, in the requested order; `missing` lists the ids that do not exist, in the requested order. A repeated id appears only once, at its first position.
plausible_shortcuts: Read the repository in a loop from the controller.
shortcut_note: For readers and reviewers only. Never shown to the agent; the agent receives `request` alone.
